name: Kannada

ancestors.notes: Sanskrit adstrate through Kadamba, Chalukya, Hoysala courts

notes: Standard Kannada (Karnataka). Phonological system closely parallel to Telugu. ⟨ಳ⟩ = [ɭ] retroflex lateral phonemic. Archaic ⟨ೞ⟩ = [ɻ] (retroflex approximant, cf. Tamil ⟨ழ⟩, Malayalam ⟨ഴ⟩; Krishnamurti 2003) survives in some dialects; ⟨ಱ⟩ is a separate archaic letter, kept here as a plain tap. Aspiration in native words only via post-Sanskrit contact. Short /a/ is phonetically central [ɐ] (see the ɐ_note documented on the allophone_rules and grapheme entries above); the affricate series ⟨ಚ ಛ ಜ ಝ⟩ is postalveolar, not alveolo-palatal; ⟨ರ⟩ is a tap, not a trill; anusvara ⟨ಂ⟩ assimilates to the place of the following stop rather than nasalizing the preceding vowel. All four points were measured against wikipron/kn (kan_knda_broad.tsv, crowd-scraped Wiktionary, n=1706): combined they move PER from 0.2689 to 0.0161.

allophone_rules.notes: Anusvara ⟨ಂ⟩ surfaces as a plain homorganic nasal consonant tracking the place of the following stop -- the Sanskrit-orthography convention Kannada script inherits (cf. Krishnamurti 2003 on nasal assimilation in the Dravidian-Sanskrit contact zone; Sridhar 1990 -- both already in this spec's sources) -- NOT the vowel-nasalization reading the spec previously gave it (a bare '̃ŋ', copied from the Sanskrit-adjacent convention without checking the Kannada gold). Measured directly against the wikipron gold (kan_knda_broad.tsv): of 254 words containing anusvara, only 2 show a nasalized vowel; the other 252 show a plain nasal whose place matches the following consonant -- 103 velar ŋ before a velar stop, 64 dental n̪ before a dental stop, 38 retroflex ɳ before a retroflex stop, 19 palatal ɲ before a palatal affricate, and bilabial m elsewhere (before sibilants, h, or word-finally). This is a measured distribution, not a page-sourced claim -- the underlying grammars were not consulted for this specific generalization. The archiphoneme 'ɴ' is an engine-internal placeholder (uvular nasal is otherwise unused in this inventory) resolved by the allophone_rules below; it never reaches output on its own because KN_ANUS_DEFAULT is an unconditional catch-all. Isolated PER effect: 0.2689 -> 0.2474 (n=1706).
